definition: Suggestion — the power of poetic language to suggest meaning beyond denotation and metaphor. Rasadhvani (suggested rasa) is the soul of poetry: the rasa is suggested without perceptible sequence (asaṃlakṣya-krama-vyaṅgya). The cloud is never told to carry a message; it is addressed as if it already knows.

sources.claim: dhvani is the soul of poetry (kāvyasya ātmā dhvaniḥ)
rasadhvani is the highest form of suggestion; rasa is suggested, not stated

translations.note: 'Suggestion' is the standard; 'resonance' captures the after-effect; 'evocation' captures the non-statement.
